The main takeaway from our work is that
the periplasmatic domain of ExbB presents a novel fold, which is related to siderophore‐transporter binding proteins.
the ExbD peripasmic domain has an unexpected fold that resembles that of siderophore‐bound proteins, and that the main interactions between ExbD and TonB occur at the membrane level.
the periplasmatic domain of ExbB has a structural homology with the siderophore binding protein, which is a new and exciting finding that opens new perspectives for the study of TonB system.
